# Wei Chun Chuang — learning apps for the I Ching, Bazi, Zi Wei Dou Shu and astrology

> Four iPhone apps that teach Chinese metaphysics and Western astrology in plain language. Free beginner lessons, Traditional Chinese and English, no account, data stays on device. Learning tools, not fortune-telling services.

## Apps
- [易見 YiJian](https://mm7382.github.io/yijian/): YiJian (易見): iPhone course teaching the I Ching from zero. 8 interactive beginner lessons (3 free), guided reading of all 64 hexagrams with diagrams and quizzes, spaced review and mistakes notebook. Casting is a practice feature for reflection. Traditional Chinese and English. No account. In App Store review. Details: https://mm7382.github.io/yijian/llms.txt
- [時來－八字 Shilai – Bazi](https://mm7382.github.io/bazi/): Shilai – Bazi: beginner iPhone course for reading your own Bazi (Four Pillars) chart. App calculates the chart; 20 plain-language lessons (3 free) cover pillars, stems and branches, Five Phases, Day Master, Ten Gods, combinations and clashes. Ungraded quizzes, daily question, notes and review. Traditional Chinese and English. No account; data on device. In App Store review.
- [時來－紫微 SHILAI Ziwei](https://mm7382.github.io/ziwei/): SHILAI Ziwei: iPhone course for reading your own Zi Wei Dou Shu (Purple Star Astrology) twelve-palace chart. 36 lessons (3 free, usable before creating a chart); each explanation labelled classical passage / restatement / own wording, classical lines only from Ziwei Doushu Quanshu vols 1–3. No fortune verdicts. Traditional Chinese and English. No account. Coming soon.
- [時來－星座 Shilai Astrology](https://mm7382.github.io/astrology/): Shilai Astrology: iPhone app teaching Western astrology in plain language. 3 free lessons (what a chart is; Sun/Moon/Ascendant; modalities and elements of the signs). Placidus chart; without a birth time it shows only what is certain and leaves Ascendant/houses blank. Today's sky with the triggering transit shown. Public-domain sources (Ptolemy, Lilly, NASA). No account, offline. In development.
